s1.syndrome_frame: Congenital neurological condition with prenatal intracranial hemorrhage and postnatal neurological abnormalities
salient_findings: Intracranial hemorrhage detected on fetal ultrasound and MRI
Porencephalic cyst in the right frontotemporal-insular region
Mild upper limb hypertonicity and abnormal deep tendon reflexes
key_facts: Male neonate born at 38 weeks' gestation
Birth weight 2350g (5th-10th percentile)
Length 45cm (5th percentile)
Head circumference 31cm (<5th percentile)
Apgar scores 8 and 9 at 1 and 5 minutes
Maternal history of febrile episode in periconceptional period
Fetal ultrasound at 20 weeks suggested intracranial hemorrhage
Fetal MRI at 25 weeks confirmed porencephalic cyst
Normal laboratory studies including complete blood count and coagulation profile
Normal gene sequencing for MTHFR and factor V Leiden
Newborn metabolic screening negative
Cranial ultrasound on day 1 showed porencephalic area and germinolytic cyst

differentials: Mitochondrial myopathy, encephalopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes (MELAS)
per_call: Mitochondrial myopathy, encephalopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes (MELAS)

shortlist.label: Porencephaly
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal MRI at 25 weeks confirmed porencephalic cyst and cranial ultrasound on day 1 showed porencephalic area

shortlist.label: Congenital cytomegalovirus infection
shortlist.why_kept: Maternal history of febrile episode in periconceptional period and fetal ultrasound suggested intracranial hemorrhage

shortlist.label: Fetal stroke
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal ultrasound at 20 weeks suggested intracranial hemorrhage and fetal MRI at 25 weeks showed porencephalic cyst

shortlist.label: Schizencephaly
shortlist.why_kept: Fetal MRI at 25 weeks showed abnormal micropolygyria of the right frontal cortex

shortlist.label: Congenital disorder of glycosylation
shortlist.why_kept: Microcephaly, jaundice, and abnormal deep tendon reflexes are consistent with this diagnosis

raw.rationale: Fetal MRI at 25 weeks confirmed porencephalic cyst, consistent with porencephaly diagnosis

rejected.label: Arteriovenous malformation
rejected.why: No vascular malformations found on MRI

rejected.label: Congenital cytomegalovirus infection
rejected.why: Maternal CMV serology showed IgG positive, IgM negative, indicating past infection, not recent

rejected.label: Fetal stroke
rejected.why: Although fetal ultrasound suggested intracranial hemorrhage, porencephaly is a more specific diagnosis given the presence of a porencephalic cyst

rejected.label: Schizencephaly
rejected.why: No evidence of abnormal brain clefts or slits, characteristic of schizencephaly

rejected.label: Congenital disorder of glycosylation
rejected.why: Newborn metabolic screening was negative, reducing likelihood of this diagnosis
